chunks: Abu Ja‘far al-Baqir عليه السلام said:
When one of you uncovers himself for urination or for other than that, then let him say: 'In the name of Allah,' for indeed the Shaytan lowers his gaze away from him until he finishes.

key_terms.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ: in the name of Allah; a formula of remembrance and seeking blessing
key_terms.يَغُضُّ بَصَرَهُ: lowers his gaze; turns his sight away

ai.seo_question: What should a person say when uncovering himself to relieve himself according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches an etiquette of remembrance when uncovering oneself to relieve oneself or for a similar need. By saying 'Bismillah,' the person seeks divine protection, and the hadith states that the Shaytan turns his gaze away until the act is completed.
